木.body: Growth runs through the whole season. Same direction can feel dull — try new ways on purpose.
Growth energy deepens. Focus on the roots, not just visible results.
Growth spills over. Don't try to do it all at once — pick your spots.

火.body: Passion burns through the whole season. Pacing matters more than intensity.
Passion turns inward. Chase what you truly love, not just what shines.
Too many things you want to do. Pick one or two — that's where the fruit comes.

土.body: Stability runs through the season. Keep small changes going so you don't drift.
Foundations firm up in the unseen. Don't rush — stack one brick at a time.
Roots deepen below the surface. Quiet effort now becomes lasting strength.

金.body: Clarity sharpens for the season. Sharp can cut — stay soft where it matters.
Your sense of right and wrong gets sharper. Just don't lose flexibility.
Lines get drawn — mine vs. yours, do vs. don't. Those boundaries keep you safe.

水.body: Flexibility deepens through the season. Flowing too long loses center — pause to check in.
Flexibility spreads in many directions. Spread too thin and you lose depth.
Blocked flows open up. When new paths appear, don't overthink.

木.body: Growth energy pushes from behind. Take it in — and pass it on.
Growth fills you from within. In quiet fullness, find what you want to do.
Growth raises you up. Seeds planted now become big trees in a few years.

火.body: Passion warmly surrounds you. Expand freely this season.
Passion lights the road ahead. Dark places slowly become visible.
Passion moves you. Stop thinking in your head — move your body.

土.body: Stability holds you firmly. Bold moves are safe on this ground.
Stability embraces you warmly. Rest when you need to.
Stability protects you. Focus on keeping what you have.

金.body: Clarity refines you. Blurry things gradually become sharp.
Clarity puts you on your center. Wobbling things settle into place.
Clarity wakes what was sleeping. Pull out decisions you've been putting off.

水.body: Flexibility fills you. Quiet help arrives from unexpected places.
Flexibility moves through you. Stuck places unstick naturally.
Flexibility cleanses you. Old emotions wash away and you feel lighter.

木.body: You make things grow. The more you give, the more comes back.
You nurture things. Consistency ends up making the biggest difference.
You bring things to bloom. What you've been preparing comes out into the world.

火.body: You generate passion. Creative and expressive work shines brightest.
You burn bright. You light up the people around you.
Your passion spreads. Shared fire burns bigger than private fire.

土.body: You lay ground. Small results stack up one by one.
You stack things up patiently. Invisible now, but firming up.
You set your place in the world. Wobbling things find their feet.

金.body: You set direction. Solid outcomes begin landing.
You sharpen things carefully. Precision makes the difference.
You set firm standards. That standard will guide the years ahead.

水.body: You open new roads. Making flow lets you go further.
You make flow itself. Like water carving a channel, you carve the way.
You connect what was apart — people, ideas, pieces.

木.body: Growth energy is strong. You tidy it and set your own footing.
You cut away clutter to keep direction. Less shows more.
You hold scattered things together. The grip itself becomes strength.

火.body: Passion energy is strong. You cool it and take a step back.
You calm what's hot. Wisdom to handle the fire.
You handle the flame. Handle it well and it becomes great light.

土.body: Stability energy is strong. You shape it and steady the flow.
You make ground. Scattered things come together.
You try hard not to wobble. The grip becomes your center.

金.body: Clarity energy is strong. Your fire beats it into the shape you want.
You cut things away. What grows back after the cut is stronger.
You hold the edge steady. Strong center organizes what's around it.

水.body: Flexibility energy is strong. You hold it and center yourself.
You grip flowing things. Grip too tight and the flow stops.
You tidy tangled flows. Ordered flow goes farther.

木.body: Growth energy shakes you. The more you're tested, the deeper you root.
Growth refines you. Even when it's hard, you come out firmer.
Growth tests your edge. Today's wall is tomorrow's door.

火.body: Fire tempers you. Heat makes you harder, in a good way.
Fire smooths your rough edges. Friction is growth.
Fire wakes you. Discomfort is the start of change.

土.body: Stability contains you. Walls make you go deeper.
Stability refines you. Familiar ground becomes a launch point.
Stability holds you. It can feel tight — but it holds long.

金.body: Clarity cuts you. What grows back is stronger.
Clarity sets you straight. Messy things get arranged.
Clarity tests your real will. The answer is already inside you.

水.body: Flexibility covers you. You don't sink — you rise like steam.
Flexibility washes you. Old things fall away; the mind clears.
Flexibility flows you along. Let go, and flow takes you.

danger: Same direction gets dull fast. Build in new stimulation on purpose.
You could stall. Add something new on purpose.
warning: Complacency is coming. Try one new thing at a time.
Boredom creeps in. Make small changes.
neutral: Keep the flow, but prep a small change.
Your pace is good. Just watch for routine.
positive: Enjoy this grain. Same-direction forces push each other.
Soak it in. Similar energy strengthens you.

danger: Only receiving makes you numb. Give back what you get.
One-way receiving sours. Pass it on.
warning: As you fill up, don't forget to pass it on.
Receiving only dulls you. Practice giving.
neutral: Be grateful, and let it flow.
Balance receiving with giving.
positive: Use this support well — it becomes a big leap.
Make the most of this lift. It's a launch window.

danger: Giving drains you. Fill yourself first.
Give-only empties you. Care for yourself first.
warning: Check the balance of giving and receiving.
Give — but don't lose yourself.
neutral: Give — but not past your limit.
Share moderately. It lasts longer.
positive: The more you give, the more you're filled. Share freely.
Share your abundance. It grows.

danger: Holding too tight hurts the bond. Let go of what you can't hold.
Grip too hard and it slips. Time to loosen.
warning: Handle it — don't control it. Practice loosening your grip.
Control impulse rises. Pause a beat.
neutral: Manage it gently, and find balance.
Your pace is fine. Keep flexibility.
positive: Your handling is good right now. Keep this pace.
This tuning is spot on. Remember this feel.

danger: Pressure feeds urgency. Don't race against others' pace.
Not the time to push back. Let the current carry you.
warning: Don't resist now — let the current carry you.
Acceptance works better than resistance here.
neutral: Acknowledge the pressure, keep your pace.
Let it flow — but don't lose center.
positive: A bit of pressure is fuel for growth.
Use this pressure as fuel. Big leaps come from it.

danger: Keep the current way — but change one thing on purpose.
Start small: one change a day.
warning: Try one new thing per quarter.
Once a month, choose differently.
neutral: Try one new approach each year.
Add new stimulus each quarter.
positive: Enjoy the rhythm and stretch that strength further.
Lift this flow to the next level.

danger: Pass it on. If you don't, you'll go numb.
Journal what you get — and return it.
warning: Show gratitude for what you receive — words or actions.
Share a little of what you've received.
neutral: Journal what you receive. Return it as gratitude.
Share your gains in small ways.
positive: Use this support well. This is your expansion window.
Apply this lift to a big goal. A seed for a leap.

danger: Fill yourself first. This isn't the giving season — it's refill time.
One day a week, fully for you.
warning: Check the balance of giving and receiving once.
Before giving, check your own cup.
neutral: Keep one full day a week just for you.
Protect time to refill as much as you give.
positive: Give freely. The more you give, the more you fill.
Pass on this abundance. It multiplies.

danger: Practice letting go — one thing a day.
Today, let one decision flow.
warning: Loosen your grip. Handle it, don't control it.
Before deciding, ask: 'Do I really need to hold this?'
neutral: Before deciding, ask: 'Do I really need to control this?'
Once a day, notice the urge to control.
positive: Keep this feel. You're in a good groove.
Note this rhythm — reuse it later.

danger: Protect your pace. Don't race against others' speed.
5 minutes a day: breathe and follow the current.
warning: Reduce resistance. Let the current carry you.
Once a day, accept what you can't control.
neutral: Build one skill a year that lasts the next decade.
One day a week, go without plans.
positive: Turn the pressure into fuel. It's your growth engine.
Use this pressure as a step to the next level.
